post.description:
Extract the subtitles of a YouTube link. The link is queued (NS-11 stage 7): the answer comes at once, the queue worker does
the extraction in its turn, and /api/status/{task_id} follows it. A link that is already queued returns the same task.

Upload a local audio/video file for transcription. The upload is saved and queued (NS-11 stage 5): the answer comes at
once, the queue worker transcribes it in its turn; /api/status/{task_id} follows it.

delete.description:
Stop the transcription of an uploaded file (NS-11 stage 5): a queued one is taken out of the queue, a running one is told
to stop (it ends after the segment in hand). Either way nothing is saved, so a saved transcript stays as it was.

get.description: Return all queue items ordered by sort_order + added_at.

delete.description: Clear all pending queue items (does not touch processing/done/failed).

post.description:
Add multiple URLs to the processing queue. Skips duplicates (already processed or in queue).

Every skipped link has an explicit reason: `invalid` lists the links that are not YouTube links; `duplicates` lists the rest
and `duplicate_details` gives each one's video id and reason: "processed", "in_queue", "in_list" (the same video is earlier
in this very list) or, for video_ids, "order". The links that were added come back in `ids`, in the order they were sent.
`report` repeats it as one entry per link in the order sent: {url, video_id, status} with status added / processed / in_queue /
in_list / invalid (the page shows it as it is). An invalid entry also has `reason`: "http_only" (an http:// link to YouTube:
only https links are accepted) or "not_youtube".

`video_ids` queues results that are already in History by id (the only way to queue a local file);
they can only run the LLM stages (cleanup, summary, mindmap).

`force` applies to `urls` only: it skips the "already processed / already in the queue" check so a
video can be re-run. `video_ids` ignore it: an id that is already pending or processing is always
reported as a duplicate (two runs of the same stage on one video would overwrite each other). Stage-aware (NS-25):
only the stages that a queued item already includes are skipped; the other requested stages are still queued, and a
duplicate names the stages that are already queued.
At most 500 urls and 500 video_ids per request.

get.description: Return item counts per status — for nav badge.

delete.description:
Clear all failed queue items, and the partial items that are stuck (nothing left to retry). A partial item that
can still be retried is kept.

post.description: Reset all failed and partial queue items to pending; a partial item restarts only its failed stages.

delete.description: Delete a single pending queue item.

post.description:
The Cancel button of a queue row (NS-16): a waiting item is taken out of the queue, a running one is told to stop (it ends
`skipped` when its current step returns; what it had saved stays).
Reset a single failed or partial queue item to pending.

The result page's Stop (NS-16): cancels every waiting or running job of this video, whatever its stage. Waiting ones leave
the queue, a running one is told to stop. Nothing running is not an error (the job may have just finished).

delete.description:
Stop the cleanup: a queued one is taken out of the queue, a running one is told to stop (it ends after the
paragraph in hand). Either way the status goes back to "nothing running" and a previous cleaned text is kept.

post.description:
Queue the AI cleanup. The status is 'processing' at once (the page shows progress while the item waits its turn
behind the queue); the queue worker does the work. A second click while one is queued or running adds nothing
(NS-11 stage 4a).

get.description: Download video/audio via yt-dlp. Returns the file as an attachment.

delete.description:
Stop the mind map: a queued one is taken out of the queue, a running one is told to stop.

Either way the status goes back to "nothing running" and a saved map is kept (as in the background copy).

post.description:
Queue the mind map. Returns the saved map unless force=true (the page's "Regenerate").

The status is 'processing' at once (the page shows progress while the item waits its turn behind the queue); the
queue worker does the work. A second click while one is queued or running adds nothing (NS-11 stage 2).

delete.description:
Stop a re-extract / re-transcribe: a queued one leaves the queue, a running one ends after the segment in hand. Either way
nothing is replaced: the saved subtitles and what was made from them stay (NS-11 decision 1).

post.description:
Re-fetch subtitles (YouTube) or re-transcribe (uploaded file) for an existing video; invalidates what was made from the old
text. The work is a queue item (NS-11 stage 6): the answer comes at once, the queue worker does it in its turn.

delete.description:
Stop the summarization: a queued one is taken out of the queue, a running one is told to stop.

Either way the status goes back to "nothing running" and a previous summary is kept (as in the background copy).

post.description:
Queue the summarization. The status is 'processing' at once (the page shows progress while the item waits its
turn behind the queue); the queue worker does the work. A second click while one is queued or running adds nothing
(NS-11 stage 3).
